At $t=\dfrac27$: $V=35\cos\left(\dfrac{7\pi}{3}\times\dfrac27\right)+85=35\cos\dfrac{2\pi}{3}+85=67.5$.

At $t=\dfrac37$, which is halfway through a period, the volume is at its minimum, $V=50$.

Volume pumped out $=67.5-50=17.5\approx18$ mL.

$V=102.5$: $17.5=35\cos\left(\dfrac{7\pi t}{3}\right)$, so $\cos\left(\dfrac{7\pi t}{3}\right)=\dfrac12$, so $\dfrac{7\pi t}{3}=\dfrac\pi3$ the first time this occurs, so $t=\dfrac17$.

Fraction of time $=\dfrac{1/7}{3/7}=\dfrac13$.

solutions.latex:
Let $u=kx$, $v=e^{kx}$: $u'=k$, $v'=ke^{kx}$.

$y'=vu'+uv'=ke^{kx}+k^2xe^{kx}=ke^{kx}(1+kx)$.

$y'=0$: $ke^{kx}=0$ has no solution, so $1+kx=0$, $x=-\dfrac1k$ is the only stationary point.

When $x=-\dfrac1k$, $y=k\left(-\dfrac1k\right)e^{k(-1/k)}=-e^{-1}$, which is independent of $k$.

$P(A\mid\text{same colour})=\dfrac{P(A\text{ and same colour})}{P(\text{same colour})}$

$P(ARR\text{ or }AGG)=\dfrac12\times\dfrac26\times\dfrac15+\dfrac12\times\dfrac46\times\dfrac35=\dfrac{7}{30}$

$P(\text{same colour})=\dfrac7{30}+\dfrac12\times\dfrac36\times\dfrac25+\dfrac12\times\dfrac36\times\dfrac25=\dfrac{13}{30}$

$P(A\mid\text{same colour})=\dfrac{7/30}{13/30}=\dfrac7{13}$

solutions.latex:
Let $B_n$ be the amount owing $n$ months after 1st April 2022. The rate is $3.6\%$ p.a. $=0.3\%$ per month, and $M$ is the new monthly repayment.

$B_n=571\,367\times1.003^n-\dfrac{M(1.003^n-1)}{1.003-1}$

When $n=276$, $B_n=0$: $0=571\,367\times1.003^{276}-\dfrac{M(1.003^{276}-1)}{0.003}$

$M=\dfrac{571\,367\times1.003^{276}\times0.003}{1.003^{276}-1}=3047.09656\ldots\approx\$3047.10$
